comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments, but the constructs differ. Item 0 requires first-hand or personally situated details of a labor process: the commenter's own or a specific person's work tasks, hours, tools and conditions. Item 1 requires a specific, verifiable procedural example of how a legal, administrative, scientific or institutional process, rule or protocol works in a specific case, used as support for a rebuttal. It is not limited to labor or personal experience. A personal work anecdote may not be a checkable institutional procedure, and an institutional or legal procedure need not be personal labor. The attribution and eligibility rules also differ: item 0 excludes quoted text and bot/moderator notices, while item 1 only ignores quoted OP text.
